milestone: Shared native formatter and language-server integration
implementation: Add syntax-only native formatter preserving physical line breaks, comments, string/numeric token spellings and declaration order
Normalize horizontal spacing, two-space block indentation where layout permits, LF endings and final newline
Verify complete token-kind sequences including layout, non-layout token spellings, reparsing and NameExpr source payloads; retain original indentation on the conservative second attempt
Bound input/output through compiler limits and at most two candidates; reject unverified output with F001 and no text
Add kalandra-fmt stdout and --check modes without source writes
Expose Format Document for registered open buffers using whole-document original-file UTF-16 edits without buffer mutation or dependency resolution

coverage: Exact style output and idempotence across 319 native fixtures
Comments, String escapes, Unicode, CRLF, blank/comment-only buffers and missing final newline
Unary signs, word negation, indexing/calls, record construction and multiline collection indentation
Rejection of malformed syntax, tabs, invalid UTF-8 and source/output limit violations
Significant device-selector spelling preserved or rejected without repair
CLI stdout/check status, invalid arguments, extension rejection, read failures and unchanged source files
Stdio capability negotiation and independently applied whole-document Unicode/CRLF edits
Editor-applied updates, repeat requests, fixed style options, invalid/closed buffers, unresolved imports and verification refusal
Existing selected syntax, semantic, module/package/project, error, closure/callable and editor-tooling regressions
qualification.third_party_sanitization: LLVM libraries are not rebuilt with sanitizers

limitations: Fixed style with preserved physical line breaks; no long-line wrapping or complete AST reprint
Canonical indentation can fall back to original indentation to retain layout
No in-place writes, stdin, recursive CLI discovery, range formatting or on-type formatting
Synchronous requests without cancellation or concurrent/stale-result guarantees
No real-editor or additional-platform qualification; third-party LLVM not sanitizer-built
No runtime/backend/GPU, distributed, interop, JS-prototype or website changes
